mapper.sql: auto_id AS autoId, student_id AS studentId, day_of_week AS dayOfWeek, seq AS seq, enabled AS enabled, filled_until AS filledUntil, no_pass_at AS noPassAt, CASE WHEN enabled = 0 THEN 'OFF' WHEN no_pass_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'NO_PASS' ELSE 'ON' END AS state
mapper.select: SELECT FROM erp_bookstore_auto_reservation WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY day_of_week, seq
SELECT FROM erp_bookstore_auto_reservation WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY auto_id
SELECT FROM erp_bookstore_auto_reservation WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND enabled = 1 ORDER BY day_of_week, seq
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_auto_reservation (student_id, day_of_week, seq, enabled, filled_until) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{dayOfWeek}, #{seq}, 1, #{filledUntil})
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_bookstore_auto_reservation SET enabled = 1, filled_until = #{filledUntil}, no_pass_at = NULL, updated_at = DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()) WHERE auto_id = #{autoId}
UPDATE erp_bookstore_auto_reservation SET enabled = 0, no_pass_at = NULL, updated_at = DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()) WHERE auto_id = #{autoId} AND enabled = 1

UPDATE erp_bookstore_auto_reservation SET filled_until = #{filledUntil}, updated_at = DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()) WHERE auto_id = #{autoId} AND (filled_until IS NULL OR filled_until < #{filledUntil})
UPDATE erp_bookstore_auto_reservation SET no_pass_at = #{today}, updated_at = DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()) WHERE auto_id = #{autoId} AND no_pass_at IS NULL
UPDATE erp_bookstore_auto_reservation SET no_pass_at = NULL, updated_at = DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()) WHERE auto_id = #{autoId} AND no_pass_at IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT notice_id AS noticeId, student_id AS studentId, message FROM erp_bookstore_auto_notice WHERE sent_at IS NULL ORDER BY student_id, notice_id
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_bookstore_auto_notice SET sent_at = DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()) WHERE sent_at IS NULL AND notice_id IN #{id}
